citations.quote: ZELSUVM is a nitric oxide releasing agent. The mechanism of action for the treatment of molluscum contagiosum is unknown.
Berdazimer sodium (also known as NVN1000) is a new molecular entity (NME), and it is a topical nitric oxide (NO) releasing agent developed for the topical treatment of molluscum contagiosum (MC)

modality.text: Small molecule (topical nitric oxide-releasing agent; berdazimer sodium)

citations.quote: ZELSUVM1 (SB206 gel, 10.3%) consists of berdazimer sodium (NVN1000) gel, a new molecular entity (NME), and a proton-donating hydrogel. Mixing the two gels prior to the topical application to MC lesions releases nitric oxide (NO), a pharmacologically active agent.
